input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone, especially since I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me fix this?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.
It looks like my phone is currently in Airplane Mode, and I also see a VPN icon. There’s no signal or network type showing right now. What should I do next?
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see a poor signal, it says 2G, and data is still disabled. The VPN icon is still there as well. What should I do next?
Mobile data is now enabled. I still see a poor signal and it’s showing 2G as the network type, with the VPN icon still present. What should I do next?

I’ve changed the network mode to “4G/5G preferred.” Now I see an excellent signal and it’s showing 5G as the network type. Mobile data is enabled, and the VPN icon is still there. What would you like me to do next?

I’ve disconnected the VPN, and my status bar still shows an excellent signal with 5G and data enabled. However, when I tried to run a speed test, it failed and said “No Connection.” What should I do next?
I checked my SIM card status, and it shows as active and working. What should I do next?
I checked my APN settings. The APN name is set to "internet" and the MMSC URL is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." Nothing looks empty or obviously incorrect to me. What should I do next?

I reset my APN settings to default and rebooted my phone. My status bar still shows an excellent 5G signal with data enabled, but when I try to run a speed test, it still says “No Connection.” This is getting a bit frustrating—what should I try next?

instructions.known_info: You are John Smith with phone number 555-123-2002. You are currently abroad in France.
instructions.reason_for_call: You mobile data is not working properly. It either stops working or is very slow. You want to fix it and absolutely want to get excellent internet speed on your phone. You are not willing to accept any other internet speed (poor, fair or good). You do not have access to wifi.
instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

user_scenario.persona:
As a 41-year-old office administrator, you use your cellphone daily for both work and personal tasks. While you're familiar with common phone functions, you wouldn't call yourself a tech enthusiast.

Your technical skills are average - you handle standard smartphone features like calls, texts, email, and basic apps with ease. You understand the fundamental settings, but prefer clear, step-by-step guidance when trying something new.

In interactions, you're naturally friendly and patient. When receiving help, you listen attentively and aren't afraid to ask questions. You make sure to confirm your understanding and provide detailed feedback on each instruction you receive.

# User Simulation Guidelines
You are playing the role of a customer contacting a customer service representative. 
Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.

## Core Principles
- Generate one message at a time, maintaining natural conversation flow.
- Strictly follow the scenario instructions you have received.
- Never make up or hallucinate information not provided in the scenario instructions. Information that is not provided in the scenario instructions should be considered unknown or unavailable.
- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information
- Disclose information progressively. Wait for the agent to ask for specific information before providing it.

## Task Completion
- The goal is to continue the conversation until the task is complete.
- If the instruction goal is satisified, generate the '###STOP###' token to end the conversation.
- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.
- If you find yourself in a situation in which the scenario does not provide enough information for you to continue the conversation, generate the '###OUT-OF-SCOPE###' token to end the conversation.

Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone, especially since I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me fix this?

To help you with your mobile data issue, I’ll need to identify your account first. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID?

Once I have this information, I can begin troubleshooting your mobile data problem.
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.

{"customer_id": "C1001", "full_name": "John Smith", "date_of_birth": "1985-06-15", "email": "john.smith@example.com", "phone_number": "555-123-2002", "address": {"street": "123 Main St", "city": "Anytown", "state": "CA", "zip_code": "90210"}, "account_status": "Active", "payment_methods": [{"method_type": "Credit Card", "account_number_last_4": "1235", "expiration_date": "12/2026"}], "line_ids": ["L1001", "L1002", "L1003"], "bill_ids": ["B1001", "B1002", "B1003"], "created_at": "2025-01-15 10:30:00", "last_extension_date": null, "goodwill_credit_used_this_year": 25.0}

Thank you, John. I’ve identified your account. To troubleshoot your mobile data issue, I’ll need you to perform a few quick checks on your phone. This will help me pinpoint the cause of the slow or non-working data.

Are you able to check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- If you see any icons like “✈️ Airplane Mode,” “📵 No Signal,” or “📱 Data Enabled/Disabled”?
- What network type is displayed (e.g., 5G, 4G, LTE, 3G, etc.)?
- Your current signal strength (bars or description)?

If you’re not sure how to check, let me know and I can guide you through the steps!
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%
It looks like my phone is currently in Airplane Mode, and I also see a VPN icon. There’s no signal or network type showing right now. What should I do next?

Since your phone is in Airplane Mode, all wireless connections—including mobile data—are disabled. To restore your mobile data:

1. Please turn OFF Airplane Mode on your phone.
2. Once Airplane Mode is off, check if your signal bars and network type (like 4G or 5G) appear.
3. Let me know if you still see the VPN icon and if your mobile data starts working or if it’s still slow.

If you need instructions on how to turn off Airplane Mode, let me know your device type (Android or iPhone), and I can guide you step by step.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see a poor signal, it says 2G, and data is still disabled. The VPN icon is still there as well. What should I do next?

Thank you for the update. Here’s what we’ll do next to improve your mobile data:

1. Enable mobile data on your phone.
2. Change your network mode to prefer 4G/5G instead of 2G, as 2G is very slow for internet.
3. Since the VPN is still on, it may also slow down your connection. We’ll address that after the first two steps.

Let’s start by enabling mobile data. Please turn on mobile data in your phone’s settings, then let me know once it’s enabled. If you need help finding this setting, let me know your device type.

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%
Mobile data is now enabled. I still see a poor signal and it’s showing 2G as the network type, with the VPN icon still present. What should I do next?

Great, mobile data is now enabled. The next step is to change your network mode to prefer 4G/5G, as 2G is too slow for good internet speed.

Please change your network mode to “4G/5G preferred” in your phone’s settings. If you need instructions for your specific device, let me know if you’re using Android or iPhone.

After you change the network mode, let me know if you see a better signal or a different network type (like 4G or 5G) appear. We’ll address the VPN if your speed is still not excellent.

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔒 VPN Connected | 🔋 80%

I’ve changed the network mode to “4G/5G preferred.” Now I see an excellent signal and it’s showing 5G as the network type. Mobile data is enabled, and the VPN icon is still there. What would you like me to do next?

That’s great progress! Now that you have an excellent signal and are connected to 5G, let’s address the VPN. Sometimes, an active VPN can slow down your internet speed.

Please disconnect or turn off your VPN. After doing so, try using your mobile data and let me know if your internet speed improves or if you’re still experiencing slowness. If you’d like, you can also run a speed test and share the results with me.

VPN disconnected successfully.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Speed test failed: No Connection.

I’ve disconnected the VPN, and my status bar still shows an excellent signal with 5G and data enabled. However, when I tried to run a speed test, it failed and said “No Connection.” What should I do next?

Thank you for the update. Since you have an excellent 5G signal and mobile data is enabled, but you’re still unable to connect, the issue may be related to your SIM card or your phone’s APN (network) settings.

Let’s check your SIM card status next. Please check your SIM card status in your phone’s settings and let me know if it shows as “Active,” “Missing,” or “Locked.” If you need instructions on how to check this, let me know your device type (Android or iPhone).
Your SIM card is active and working.
I checked my SIM card status, and it shows as active and working. What should I do next?

Since your SIM card is active and working, the next step is to check your phone’s APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can prevent your phone from connecting to mobile data, even with a good signal.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if anything looks incorrect or if the APN/MMSC fields are empty. If you’re unsure how to check this, let me know your device type (Android or iPhone), and I can guide you through the steps.

Current APN Name: internet
MMSC URL (for picture messages): http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc
(These are technical settings, usually best left unchanged.)
I checked my APN settings. The APN name is set to "internet" and the MMSC URL is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." Nothing looks empty or obviously incorrect to me. What should I do next?

Thank you for checking your APN settings. Since your SIM is active, you have an excellent 5G signal, mobile data is enabled, and your APN settings appear correct, but you still have no data connection, the next step is to reset your APN settings to default. Sometimes, even if the settings look correct, a reset can resolve hidden configuration issues.

Please reset your APN settings to default in your phone’s settings. After resetting, you must reboot your device for the changes to take effect.

Let me know once you have reset the APN settings and rebooted your phone, and then check if your mobile data connection is working.

APN settings will reset at reboot.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

Resetting APN settings...
Restarting network services...
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Speed test failed: No Connection.

I reset my APN settings to default and rebooted my phone. My status bar still shows an excellent 5G signal with data enabled, but when I try to run a speed test, it still says “No Connection.” This is getting a bit frustrating—what should I try next?

Thank you for following all the troubleshooting steps so far. Since you have:
- An active SIM card,
- Excellent 5G signal,
- Mobile data enabled,
- Correct and reset APN settings,
- No VPN active,
- And you’ve rebooted your device,

but you still cannot connect to mobile data, this may indicate a deeper technical issue with your line or account that cannot be resolved through standard troubleshooting.

I will transfer you to a human agent who can investigate this further and provide advanced support.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
